hooks.name: Docker-only dev commands
hooks.description: Asks for confirmation when a dev tool is run on the host instead of through docker compose.

action.command: IN=$(cat); echo "$IN" | grep -q 'mcp' && exit 0; if echo "$IN" | grep -Eq '"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[[:space:]]*(npm|npx|pnpm|yarn|pytest|uv|pip|pip3|uvicorn|alembic|tflint|checkov|python|python3|node)[[:space:]]' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Docker is the dev environment. Run this with docker compose run --rm <service> instead of on the host."}}'; fi; exit 0
